title: AI Grant runs a separate $5k-$50k open-source AI grant track at aigrant.org
summary: Distinct from the $250k accelerator at aigrant.com, AI Grant's aigrant.org site offers $5,000-$50,000 no-strings grants (compute or cash) for open-source AI/ML projects — libraries, file formats, model efficiency, scientific and medical applications. No listed apply portal or deadline; the org's own profile already alludes to 'a separate grant track for open-source AI projects' but the registry has no program file for it.

title: Digital Brain Project's 2026 team-application call closed May 15, selection announced May 31
summary: The org's apply page describes a 2026 call for PI-led teams (up to $500k per team over 36 months) to acquire neuroimaging data during cognitive/gameplay tasks. Call opened April 15, 2026 and closed May 15, 2026, with selection May 31, 2026 — both dates now in the past, so this round is concluded. No program file exists in the registry yet for this org.

programs/digital-brain-project-2026-call.summary: Funds PI-led teams at accredited institutions up to $500,000 over 36 months to acquire and share neuroimaging data for foundational models of intelligent behavior.

title: FPA Development Fund runs quarterly grant rounds; Q3 2026 open (closes Sep 1), Q4 announced (closes Nov 15)
summary: The FPA's Development Fund accelerates FreeCAD development with EUR 1,500-5,000 grants (EUR 40,000 reserved for 2026, distributed quarterly). Applications go through a public GitHub repo. Q1 (Mar 10) and Q2 (Jun 1) 2026 deadlines have passed; Q3 (Sep 1) is the current open window and Q4 (Nov 15) is announced. No program file exists yet for this fund.

title: FAR.AI's $12M grantmaking program is currently nomination-only, public RFPs 'coming soon'
summary: FAR.AI's grantmaking program for academics and independent researchers on critical AI risks is funded by a $12M grant from Coefficient Giving. The programs page states that, due to limited evaluation capacity, it currently only considers researchers nominated by experts with a strong track record, with public RFPs planned but not yet live. No program file exists in the registry for this.

programs/far-ai-grantmaking.yaml.summary: $12M grantmaking program (funded by Coefficient Giving) for academics and independent researchers on deception, robustness, interpretability, red-teaming, and alignment. Currently nomination-only pending limited evaluation capacity; public RFPs planned.

title: GSoC 2026 contributor applications closed Mar 31; coding period runs through Aug 31 (ext. Nov)
summary: GSoC's own timeline page gives the full 2026 cycle: mentor org applications Jan 19-Feb 3, contributor applications Mar 16-31 (now closed), acceptances Apr 30, community bonding May 1-24, coding May 25 through Aug 31 (or Nov 2-9 for the extended track). Stipends are PPP-adjusted, $750-$6,600 across small/medium/large project tiers. No program file exists yet distinct from the org file.

programs/google-summer-of-code-2026.yaml.summary: Annual global program pairing new open-source contributors with mentoring organizations for 12+ week projects, with PPP-adjusted stipends of $750-$6,600.

title: Pacifica runs a points-based Builder Program (Volume Two ran Mar 12-Jun 12, 2026) not yet in the registry
summary: Pacifica's docs describe a Builder Program rewarding developers who contribute significantly to the platform, with up to 10,000,000 points allocated for 'Volume Two' (Mar 12-Jun 12, 2026, now closed). Onboarding is by direct contact (email/Discord/Telegram), not a self-service application. This contradicts the org profile's current line that there's 'no evidence' of a builder program — see accompanying profile_note.

title: SFF-2026 adds three themed S-Process tracks (Climate Change, Animal Welfare, HSEE) alongside Main
summary: The existing SFF-2026 round in the registry only lists the Main/Freedom/Fairness tracks (closed Apr 22, 2026). SFF's own 2026 application page shows three additional themed rounds not yet in the registry: Climate Change (closed Jun 10), Animal Welfare (closed Jun 24), and Human Self-Enhancement and Empowerment/HSEE (closed Jul 8) — each with $2-4MM estimated funding, all now past their application deadlines and moving into review. Total across all 2026 rounds is estimated at $20-40MM+.
